message: viewerIsStaffMember is added to the shared fragment used by the query and both mutations, so a web deploy ahead of API #3828 (or an API rollback) breaks the whole questionnaire.
dismissalDetail: the API field is on staging with #3828 and both PRs ship together under the NSO UAT hold, like every other new questionnaire field

message: The Summary-redirect effect depends on handleStepChange, whose identity follows `steps` (memoized on `t`), so a language change re-fires it and pulls a read-only reader back to Summary.
In read-only mode the header still shows 'Last saved' and the step pages give no submitted notice, so locked fields look broken.
dismissalDetail: Last saved is still true for a submitted questionnaire; the Summary shows the submitted notice and step pages stay readable with disabled fields, per the plan

message: When viewerIsStaffMember is null, the group-based guess still treats a NewStaff spouse as the staff member and shows the wrong avatar.
dismissalDetail: the API returns null only when a person number is blank, and then the old staff group guess is the best we have

message: completeQuestionnaire returns quietly when readOnly, so handleSubmit still applies the location change and shows a success toast.
The new disabled tests assert only the input, which already gets disabled from the fieldProps spread, so the new LabeledField disabled wiring is untested.
Every LabeledField call site threads the read-only state by hand in different styles; LabeledField could read readOnly from context itself.
dismissalDetail: the shared question components take state from props like the rest of the questionnaire fields; LabeledField stays presentational

message: renderSubmitted threads the mutation spy as a parameter and the test redeclares it, against testing.md.
A submitted questionnaire first renders step 0 and then jumps to Summary in an effect, so PersonalInformation mounts and fires a query for nothing.
dismissalDetail: one render on step 1 before the jump; its queries are shared and cached, so nothing extra reaches the API

message: An unparseable completedAt makes dateFormatShort throw a RangeError and crash Summary.
The read-only Summary still runs useApplyGoalAndLocation and builds the submit Confirmation, which cannot be used once submitted.
dismissalDetail: hooks cannot be called conditionally, and the hook only reads cached settings

message: `(loading && !data) ||` is now redundant because `!data?.newStaffQuestionnaire` is already true when data is missing.
